# Security policy

Security fixes are provided for the latest released DocWen OpenClaw plugin version.

Use GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** action on the repository Security page when private vulnerability
reporting is available. If it is unavailable, open a public issue containing only a request for private
contact. Do not include exploit details, credentials, Gateway configuration, private file content, absolute
paths, or unsanitized DocWen output in a public issue.

Include the plugin, OpenClaw, DocWen, Node.js, and operating-system versions; the affected tool; the impact;
and the smallest safe reproduction. Ordinary bugs and feature requests belong in the issue forms.
